findings.text: The new Property page never says what it is (content 1, page 1). It shows a title, "listeners: 3" and a bare card of buttons, and its `description` ("One live value…") is not drawn on the page. A newcomer cannot say what they are meant to learn. See shots/…-core-Property/1200.png, band 2: the stray "listeners: 3" span sits above the card it counts.

The new Template page has the same problem (content 1). Under the title come five buttons and a muted counter line, with no sentence saying what a Template is or what the buttons do. The description is never drawn. See shots/…-core-Page-Template/1200.png, bands 2–3.

The Property page is 85–92% empty at 1200–3440 (layout.json `empty` 0.845/0.892/0.92). The demo is one small card. That is acceptable for a tiny class, but one line of text and the class structure (`class Property extends Events(Object)`, plus bind/set/listeners) would fill the space with the "show the class" rule.

The Page tab bar wraps to 3 rows at 1200 (layout.json `tab_rows` 3). This was already true before this change: Template went into the sidebar, not the tabs. It is recorded only so it is not blamed on this diff.
At 400, the A/B demo headings and "THE PALETTE" wrap to 2 lines (layout.json `wraps`). That is normal for headings at phone width.
